instruction: A candid cinematic photograph in a medium close-up shot captures an outdoor night scene decorated with warm hanging fairy lights. On the left, the young man with short dark hair and sunglasses on his head (R2) wears a white button-up shirt covered in red lipstick prints, smiling warmly. On the right, the young woman with long wavy brown hair (R1) wears a white striped crop top and white trousers, looking at him with a playful smile. She reaches her hand up to gently touch his chin. He holds a bouquet of red and white roses in front of them. The background is softly blurred, illuminated by a warm golden glow from the fairy lights.
